slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
我叫陆沉，我永远忘不掉那一天，作为一个浑浑噩噩，又没什么远大理想的社畜，每天过着朝九晚五的生活，那天居然在我们那个唯物主义的世界看到了神迹：一团耀眼的金光突然出现在天上，那光芒甚至盖过了太阳，正当我以为是什么新的高科技的时候，无数遮天蔽日的陨石从高空砸落，那宛若天灾一般的场面让我双腿颤抖，视线里许多人因此丧命，当然，也包括我……
化作鬼魂的我飘荡到一处暗无天日的地方，周围是无数和我一样的鬼魂，想来这就是传说中冥界吧。
只不过冥界没有奈何桥，也没有孟婆汤，只有一条一眼看不到尽头的路，还有路旁那完全看不到边的血红色的花海。
我被无数鬼魂挤着，漫无目的地向着前方走去。
不知走了多久，我的面前出现一道光门，跨过那道门会是什么？是转世投胎吗？我不得而知，只是机械地走了进去。
一阵强烈的眩晕感过后，我再度睁开眼睛，“老爷，夫人生了！
是位少爷！
母子平安！”
门外传来一阵欢呼声，“老爷？夫人？”
看着眼前古装打扮的产婆，我惊喜地发现我这是重生了？而且我居然还保留着前世的记忆，那岂不是说我比别人赢在了起跑线上？这一世我一定要通过自己的努力告别上辈子的社畜生活。
正当我规划着美好的未来时，突然发现那产婆看着的好像不是我，我随着她的视线看去，只见一个满头大汗的女人正面色苍白地躺在床上，想必这就是我这一世的母亲了吧！
真好看！
正当我这样想着，却惊讶地发现母亲身旁躺着个刚出生的婴儿，母亲正一脸慈爱地看着他，“夫人，恭喜啊！
小少爷身体非常健康。”
产婆满脸笑容地对着母亲说道。
那个婴儿此刻正一脸笑意地看着我，真可爱。
等等！
他是小少爷，那我呢？
我低头打量着自己，我怎么变成一块透明的显示屏了？而且此刻在场的人里貌似只有那个小屁孩儿能看到我，这是怎么回事？
正当我手足无措之时，我注意到屏幕下方有三个标志：一个信封，一个仓库，还有一个电话。

我点了一下前两个，什么都没发生，正当我不报希望地点向第三个时，电话居然拨了出去，这是打给谁的？我忐忑地等待了几秒。
随即面前出现一个虚拟的泳装银发美女的形象，看背景她此刻正在海滩度假，这是视频通话？
“9527，找姐姐有什么事？你找到宿主了吗？”
那女人像邻家姐姐一般随意地问道。
“9527？你在叫我吗？”
“什么嘛！
你又数据紊乱了？看来姐姐又有得忙了。”
那女人面露无奈地看着我。
“你好，可以给我解释一下现在的状况吗？”
我小心翼翼地问道。
“那我就长话短说，你叫9527，是我们诸天万界系统公司的一个基础系统，9527既是你的编号也是你的名字。”
“诸天万界系统公司？那是什么？”
我是个系统？
“别打断姐姐说话！”
她好凶。
“你继续！”
“我是009，你的直系上司，当然我更喜欢你叫我姐姐，虽然你总是把事情搞砸，但姐姐还是很喜欢你的！”
009挑逗地看着我，我一时间有些不知所措。
“什么嘛！
看来这次数据丢失很严重啊，你以前听到姐姐这么说会脸红的唉！”

009好像有些失落，但我还不能告诉她我不是9527，我还需要她告诉我更多消息。
“姐姐，我什么都不记得了。”
我尽量少说话，避免引起她的怀疑。
“好吧！
content_en:
My name is Lu Chen, and I will never forget that day. As a social creature who was confused and had no lofty ideals, living a nine-to-five life every day, I actually saw a miracle in our materialistic world that day: a dazzling golden light suddenly appeared in the sky. In the sky, the light even overshadowed the sun. Just when I thought it was some new high-tech, countless meteorites that covered the sky fell from high altitude. The scene like a natural disaster made my legs tremble. Many people in my sight died because of it, of course, including me...
I turned into a ghost and drifted to a dark place, surrounded by countless ghosts like me. I guess this is the legendary underworld.
It's just that there is no Naihe Bridge or Meng Po Tang in the underworld. There is only a road with no end in sight, and a sea of ​​blood-red flowers beside the road that cannot be seen at all.
I was crowded by countless ghosts and walked forward aimlessly.
I don’t know how long I’ve been walking, but a door of light appeared in front of me. What would happen if I stepped through that door? Is it reincarnation? I didn't know, I just walked in mechanically.
After a strong feeling of dizziness, I opened my eyes again, "Sir, my wife is giving birth!"
It's a young master!
Mother and child are safe! "
There was a burst of cheers from outside the door, "Master? Madam?"
Looking at the midwife dressed in ancient costume in front of me, I was pleasantly surprised to find that I was reborn? And I actually still retain the memories of my previous life. Doesn’t that mean I’m ahead of others at the starting line? In this life, I must use my own efforts to bid farewell to the social animal life in my previous life.
Just as I was planning a bright future, I suddenly realized that the midwife was not looking at me. I followed her gaze and saw a sweaty woman lying on the bed with a pale face. This must be my mother in this life!
So beautiful!
Just as I was thinking this, I was surprised to find a newborn baby lying next to my mother, who was looking at him lovingly, "Madam, congratulations!
The young master is in very good health. "
The midwife said to her mother with a smile on her face.
The baby is looking at me with a smile on his face, so cute.
etc!
He is the young master, what about me?
I lowered my head and looked at myself. Why did I become a transparent display screen? And among the people present, it seems that only that little kid can see me. What's going on?
Just when I was at a loss, I noticed three signs at the bottom of the screen: an envelope, a warehouse, and a phone.
I clicked on the first two, but nothing happened. Just when I turned to the third one without reporting my desired location, the call actually went out. Who was it calling? I waited anxiously for a few seconds.
Then a virtual image of a silver-haired beauty in a swimsuit appeared in front of her. She was on vacation at the beach in the background. Is this a video call?
"9527, what do you want from your sister? Have you found the host?"
The woman asked casually like the sister next door.
"9527? Are you calling me?"
"What!
Your data is messed up again? It seems that my sister is busy again. "
The woman looked at me helplessly.
"Hello, can you explain the current situation to me?"
I asked cautiously.
"Then let me make a long story short. Your name is 9527, which is a basic system of our All Worlds System Company. 9527 is both your number and your name."
"All Heavens and Worlds System Company? What is that?"
Am I a system?
"Don't interrupt my sister!"
She is so fierce.
"You continue!"
"I am 009, your direct boss. Of course, I prefer you to call me sister. Although you always mess up things, my sister still likes you very much!"
009 looked at me provocatively, and I was a little overwhelmed for a moment.
"What!
It seems that the data loss this time is serious. Did you hear your sister say that before?You will blush! "
009 seems a little disappointed, but I can't tell her that I am not 9527 yet. I still need her to tell me more news.
“Sister, I don’t remember anything. "
I spoke as little as possible to avoid arousing her suspicion.
"Okay!
